images.alt: European Nintendo DS Dragon Ball: Origins front box art showing Goku and his companions

rows.notes_markdown: Work-in-progress matching decompilation of the European Nintendo DS release (CDZP), using Metrowerks mwccarm. Requires your own decrypted European ROM. The compiler version remains under investigation; matched functions include raw m2c output awaiting cleanup and reused routines not yet merged into source files. This project reconstructs the DS game rather than providing a native PC port.

The compiler version remains under investigation, and automatically matched m2c output still needs cleanup. This is a source-reconstruction project, not a native PC port.
